content.short: Blockchain @ Georgia Tech provides education and resources on blockchain, cryptocurrency, and Web3 for Georgia Tech.
content.description: Blockchain @ Georgia Tech addresses the limited educational resources and opportunities for students curious about blockchain technology, cryptocurrency, and Web3 at Georgia Tech. It runs a crypto fundamentals course, hosts social and speaker events, shares a newsletter, and offers bounties and job opportunities, plus a Web3 conference and a hackathon. This initiative provides a comprehensive platform for Georgia Tech students to learn, network, gain real-world experience, and pursue high-paying careers in the Web3 field.
